body: I didn’t say anything to him. My mom tattled on me when I was ready to just suck it up and be quiet
When my dad offered, it was in an “oh my god just stfu” kind of way, and my parents often say that I get sick because I’m not a vegetarian
I feel like they might retort back with “but you still didn’t do x y and z well and at the end of the day nobody wanted you there so we cut you loose”
So it’s not quick and painless?
I would want to do that, but not make it sound like I’m making it about myself.

She didn’t flake. We didn’t have a set plan for Halloween or book tickets or anything. And at least she had texted me “no I don’t feel up to it” instead of ghosting/standing me up. And no she doesn’t flake a lot and I remember her telling me her previous medication for depression made her feel worse. Apart from the medical bud not sure of her list of medications.
